project_type: Next.js 16 App Router with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Prisma 7, Supabase Auth
build_system: npm (via node 22.23.2 installed with mise). Prisma 7 requires Node 20.19+ so must use 'eval "$(mise activate bash)"' prefix for all shell commands. bun 1.2.14 also available but npm preferred for prisma compat.
test_framework: Vitest with fast-check for property tests. 263 tests across 19 files currently pass. Tests in src/features/{name}/__tests__/ and src/shared/__tests__/
build_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build
test_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
verification_instructions: 1. eval "$(mise activate bash)" 2. npx tsc --noEmit 3. npm run lint 4. npm run test 5. npm run build (note: /review page has pre-existing build error from passing LucideIcon to Client Component - fix this first)
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ is generated by 'npx prisma generate'. content/metadata/content-index.json generated by 'npm run scan:content'. Both are gitignored or checked in as applicable.
setup_instructions: 1. eval "$(mise activate bash)" to activate node 22 2. npm install 3. npx prisma generate (needs DATABASE_URL or will fail) 4. npm run build
environment_constraints: Open internet access. No real Supabase instance available (no DATABASE_URL, no SUPABASE_URL env vars set). Prisma generate/migrate requires DATABASE_URL. createServerSupabaseClient() returns null when env vars missing - all code must handle this gracefully. Pre-existing build error on /review page must be fixed. mise.toml created with node@22.
contribution_requirements: Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). No cross-feature imports (extract to src/shared/). Server Actions for mutations. localStorage for user data until Supabase DB connected. No TODOs/placeholders/mock services. NEVER use useSyncExternalStore for one-time localStorage reads. NEVER call router.push/replace during render phase. NEVER return JSON.parse from getSnapshot. Always check createServerSupabaseClient() for null. Theme colors: Navy #002B5C, Gold #C5A258, Green #00843D, Background #0a0e14.
key_patterns: Auth actions in src/features/auth/actions/ use Server Actions with Zod validation. Dashboard reads from localStorage via hooks. Question bank has rich data layer in src/features/question-bank/data/. Flashcards use SM-2 algorithm in src/features/flashcards/utils/sm2.ts. Search modal is client-side scanning localStorage + content-index.json. Prisma client in src/shared/lib/prisma/client.ts uses null adapter placeholder. Supabase server client returns null when not configured.
directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/ - all authenticated routes. src/app/(auth)/ - sign-in/up/reset. src/app/api/ - API routes. src/features/ - 24 feature modules. src/shared/ - shared components, hooks, lib, types. src/scripts/ - CLI tools (scan-content, import-questions). prisma/ - schema + seed. content/ - PDFs organized by provider. public/ - static assets.
